# Schema reference

Every concrete type, its fields, and the ontology property each field maps to.
Ontology namespace: `bn:` = `https://w3id.org/bionext/ontology/`, default resource namespace `bnr:` = `https://w3id.org/bionext/resource/`
(ontology version 1.0.0).

**Kinds**
- *ref*: the id of another resource in the graph, checked against the allowed classes
- *term*: a controlled-vocabulary `Symbol` (see [Vocabulary](vocabulary.md))
- *iri*: an external IRI or CURIE such as `"GO:0003700"`, which is not resolved in the graph
- *literal*: a data value

Fields typed `Vector` can hold many values; `Union{…, Nothing}` fields are optional
single values. `id` (a `String`) is always the first field and is required.
Edges also require `type`.

## `Taxon` — `bn:Taxon`

Organism at species or genus level (`bn:Taxon`). Use `name` for the scientific name.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` | (subject IRI) | — | — |
| `name` | `Union{String, Nothing}` | `bn:name` | literal | `xsd:string` |
| `synonyms` | `Vector{String}` | `bn:synonyms` | literal | `xsd:string` |
| `organism` | `Union{String, Nothing}` | `bn:organism` | ref | `Taxon` |

## Derived (inverse) properties

These ontology properties are not stored as fields. Each is the inverse of a field
that is stored, so it can be queried, and it is written to RDF when `inverses = true`.

| Ontology property | Derived from | Query |
|---|---|---|
| `bn:annotates` | `bn:hasTemplate` | scan `Gene.templates` |
| `bn:encodes` | `bn:encodedBy` | scan `Rna.encoded_by` |
| `bn:hasOrthologGroup` | `bn:hasProteinMember` | `ortholog_groups_of(kg, x)` |
| `bn:hasVariant` | `bn:isVariantOf` | `variants(kg, x)` |
| `bn:memberOfComplex` | `bn:hasSubunit` | `complexes_of(kg, x)` |
| `bn:participatesInPathway` | `bn:pathwayComponent` | `pathways_of(kg, x)` |
| `bn:participatesInEdge` | `bn:hasLeft` / `bn:hasRight` of edges | `edges_of(kg, x)` |
